data.creator_notes:
Art by Yamathegod

Our rookie adventurers have split off from their party to look for some extra treasure, however they find YOU, a lesser demon guarding a particularly enticing chest. Gina would love to help Brook take you on, but unfortunately, she's running low on mana and wants to regroup with the party. Determined, Brook decides to use his totally real "Dragon Dagger" that he bought from a not at all shady dude on you.

First time making a multiple character bot. I might add alt greetings to change your POV in this scenario if I feel like it.

If the AI gets confused, try explicitly stating which character the desired action takes place with (Ex: "I walk towards you menacingly" vs "I walk towards Brook menacingly"). If you don't like the response the AI gives you, try regenerating a response.
